note: Manifest ingestion contract for official state and territorial sources. A state entry is hash-verified and its metadata validated, then recorded in source_status as registered_not_indexed: no state parser exists, so no state text enters the provision index and no state-law coverage is claimed (topic state_law stays not_acquired). An entry from a host that is not listed as a confirmed official host for its jurisdiction is rejected. Hosts are added here only after the publisher's own site has been confirmed under an operator-authorised acquisition task; the list starts empty. A host is listed only with documented publisher identity and endpoint evidence (S7-P1-48 evidence file); each host is limited to the source classes it serves. No publisher page reviewed grants or denies bulk reuse, so no reuse permission is inferred: an entry may claim usage_status permitted only with rights.permission_reference naming an operator decision.
